card.title: How to fix iPhone X with No Display or No Image

source.title: How to fix iPhone X with No Display or No Image

claims.statement: iPhone X no image is most often a blown PP3V0_DISPLAY_CONN filter FL5783 at display connector J5700.
Other causes: pry-damaged chokes L5700, L5710, L5720, L5730, L5740, or a long screw in the hole by the battery connector severing image lines.

procedure: Inspect the five chokes and the screw hole near the battery connector.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: A long screw near the battery connector can cut image lines.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
